task.description:
Step 00 git-setup. Create the feature branch feature/WF03-gh414-20260804 from a clean main. Steps:
  1. git checkout main
  2. git pull --ff-only origin main
  3. git checkout -b feature/WF03-gh414-20260804
  4. git branch --show-current -> must output: feature/WF03-gh414-20260804
  5. git status -> must show clean working tree

Return PASS only when the branch is created and pushed (or at minimum created locally and committed empty if push is blocked). Also confirm a clean working tree on main BEFORE the checkout (any unrelated modifications should be reported as PARTIAL or FAIL, not silently carried into the feature branch).
acceptance_criteria: git status shows clean working tree after branch creation
